brief: Recover registry close/create and DWORD profile/query/read semantics with shared owner and output bytes.
decl: bool registry_query_integer(RegistryInstallState &state, const RegistryQueryPlatform &platform, std::uint32_t name, std::span<std::byte,4> output);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete close/create/direct DWORD query/read wrapper with shared owner bytes, external output and live platform buffer/metadata views.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Writable 0x210-byte owner image, 4-byte output, valid synthetic identities and returning close/create/profile/query/scan callbacks. Owner and output mutations admitted; create disposition initial owner identity preserved. Actual registry/files, source dereference and text conversion remain explicit boundaries.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 1280 fresh original-instruction cases include 1024 single calls and 256 persistent six-operation sequences. Both MSVC and Zig compare owner/output bytes and ordered boundary pre-state images exactly; NDEBUG native domain tests remain active.
unresolved: Actual Windows registry/profile reads, scanf conversion and real handle/resource lifetime.
